name: Hearth Town

coordinateSystem.responsiveRule: Scale x and width by renderedWidth / 1536; scale y and height by renderedHeight / 1024. Keep a 3:2 image aspect ratio with no cropping.

scope: Art interaction layout. Interaction ideas are proposals, not implemented gameplay or API actions.

rules.residentialHomes: Scenery only; no hit regions and no entry interaction.
rules.services: The six service destinations are selectable in the asset preview.
rules.routeHabitats: Author tall grass on separate route maps.

hotspots.label: Village bakery
hotspots.description: A warm brick bakery on the western lane, with an oven chimney, bread window, and striped awning.
hotspots.role: Everyday food and a familiar face on the way through town.

hotspots.label: Village market
hotspots.description: A timber shop and open produce stalls, where the town's gardens and orchards meet its daily shopping.
hotspots.role: Everyday supplies and a reason to return to the square.

hotspots.label: Pokémon Center
hotspots.description: A small country Pokémon Center with a covered entrance, bright red roof, and garden borders.
hotspots.role: The town's welcoming stop for trainers and their partners.

hotspots.label: Town library
hotspots.description: An old stone library with a steep slate roof, book sign, and quiet garden.
hotspots.role: Knowledge, local history, and clues about the surrounding region.

hotspots.label: Pokémon daycare
hotspots.description: A yellow farmhouse with a fenced, mown play garden, shade tree, slide, and swings.
hotspots.role: A gentle community space for Pokémon care and companionship.

hotspots.label: Professor’s lab
hotspots.description: A teal-roofed research house with a glass greenhouse and carefully tended beds.
hotspots.role: The player's link to Pokémon research and the region's discoveries.

hotspots.label: Town square
hotspots.description: A mature shade tree, well, benches, and flower beds connect the town's paths.
hotspots.role: The town's shared living room and central meeting point.

hotspots.label: Road to Sunny Meadow
hotspots.description: The north road leads out to Route 1. Tall grass and wild encounters belong on those separate route maps.
hotspots.role: A clear transition between the inhabited town and exploration routes.
